title: justicia paludosa
intro: Justicia paludosa, commonly known as Marsh Justicia or Swamp Justicia, is a species of plant in the Acanthaceae family. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which have been used to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Justicia paludosa include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and cough, and its antiseptic properties, which aid in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Justicia paludosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
